Each write installs a new storage dict (is-not the previous), earlier snapshots stay untouched, captured at set/delete timepoint; asserted source-bound before and after the repair. arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'asgiref/local.py').resolve()
module = importlib.import_module('asgiref.local')
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
import asyncio
from asgiref.local import Local
async def main():
    test_local = Local()
    test_local.value = 123
    async def _test():
        assert test_local.value == 123
        del test_local.value
        assert not hasattr(test_local, 'value')
    await asyncio.create_task(_test())
    print('parent_value', test_local.value)
    assert test_local.value == 123, 'deletion leaked to parent'
    first = test_local._data.get({})
    test_local.other = 1
    second = test_local._data.get({})
    print('cow_identity', first is second)
    assert first is not second, 'write did not copy-on-write'
    assert first == {'value': 123}
    print('f2_cow_isolation', True)
asyncio.run(main())
